synopsis:
The first half of *Vector*, a twelve-part crossover that runs consecutively through four Dark Horse series and spans more than four thousand years of galactic history. This volume carries its opening two chapters, published as *Knights of the Old Republic* Volume 5 and *Dark Times* Volume 3.

On Mandalorian-occupied Taris, the Jedi Covenant sends its operative Celeste Morne into the Undercity after an artifact its seers have glimpsed four millennia in the future. What she and the fugitive Padawan Zayne Carrick find is the Muur Talisman, a Sith relic that turns the non-Force-sensitive into rakghouls and carries the waiting spirit of the Sith Lord who made it. The talisman fastens onto Morne, and all Carrick can do is seal her inside a stasis sarcophagus and promise to send help.

Help does not arrive for four thousand years. In the first years of the Empire the crew of the *Uhumele* recovers the sarcophagus, and Morne wakes on a lifeless moon into a galaxy she does not recognize. Darth Vader comes for what she carries and withdraws only when the rakghoul plague begins consuming his own troops, leaving her stranded with a Sith spirit and a horde for company.

Collecting: Knights of the Old Republic #25-28, Dark Times #11-12.
title: Star Wars: Vector Volume 1
